reviewMode: Independent. Refute, do not confirm. The current-turn Codex review of g30 leftover-join.v9 did not exist on disk at open, at any mid-review check, or at the pre-write check, and was never opened or read. No finding identifier was invented.
decision: REJECT — 2 MUST-FIX, 2 SHOULD-FIX. The substance of the remasurement is sound and is refuted on none of the fifteen dispatch attacks: leftoverDesign is [], OBL-G30-FX-AUTHORING is measured specified-not-leftover exactly once, leftover-design of the seven D-317 implementations and of the twenty-eight D-339 copies is measured stale as an authoring claim, g30 leftover-join.v4 is demoted to historical after D-321, g30 leftover-join.v5/v6/v7 stay frozen and non-current, basedOn.predecessorV6.role still reads 'Findings land at g30 leftover-join.v7', DR-117 and DR-G30 are denied throughout, and D-319 is not invented as a recorded heading. All 78 path-and-digest references and all 8 commit bindings match live bytes; the 7 fixtures/g30.v1/ files and the 28 fixtures/g30.v2/ files exist at the claimed counts across exactly the four occupancy v2 platforms with no Windows copy; required-now is live 28 and DR-G30's live token is OPEN. The closure measurement is licensed: g30-fixture-corpus.v5 remainderAfterThisCorpus expressly defers it to 'a later leftover-join remasurement succeeding g30 leftover-join.v8'. What fails is version substitution on carried-over prose. basedOn.predecessorV7.role still asserts, unscoped and in the present tense, 'Live HEAD is bc1e5304859d675feaf83df8835d26dbfaaccaf7. Last heading is D-320.' — both false at this tip and a second last-heading claimant against basedOn.d339.role, which findingDisposition.lastHeadingCustody calls sole. Every other basedOn entry was updated to 'Last-heading custody remains D-339.'; this one was missed. Separately, four findingDisposition retention receipts still name g30 leftover-join.v8 where the fields they cite now name g30 leftover-join.v9, and codexV6MustFix asserts 'predecessorV4.role preserves D-255 currency' when predecessorV4.role now reads 'Historical after D-321. Current recorded G30 leftover remasurement is g30 leftover-join.v8 (D-321)'. The findings are retained in substance; the receipts that certify their retention are false as written.
decisionRule: ACCEPT only if no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX. Measured: 2 MUST-FIX and 2 SHOULD-FIX, so the verdict is REJECT.
